title: Metabo HPT 4-1/2-Inch Angle Grinder, Includes 5 Grinding Wheels & Hard Case, 6.2-Amp Motor, Compact & Lightweight, G12SR4
description:

reviews_5s:
It's quite cheap for a name brand grinder. I've had it for a bit now and it's solid choice. The grinder is heavy in the hand, comes with wheels and a nice blow polymer case, and is ready to rock out of the box. People mention the switch being awkward, and it can be to turn on, but turning it off is quite easy. I'd believe this was on purpose just for safety reasons as it's hard to accidentally kick it on. It's strong, doesn't slow down too bad on deep plunge cuts, and rides easily in the hand. It's perfect for someone looking to get a really good tool but not the price with the added price tag of a Makita. It's a tried and true name, can't go wrong.Purchased this grinder for the sole purpose of sharpening lawnmower blades, with sandpaper flapper discs. Really nicely built- quality is there. No ought edges. Looks like a quality tool, as Ive come to expect from Metabo. Comes in a good case. I love that it's easy to store, because the case gives lots of room for the cord. The handle installs either left or right side, which is great when you need to hold it offhanded. Auger tightened up and never slipped back, off either the hard cutting discs provided or my flapper discs. Power is lower than some others, but it just depends what your intending to use it for. Really good grinder for the priceInexpensive DIY std duty grinder worked like a champ. Not commercial grade, but it did the job for me grinding concrete high spots down. Buy a $20 vacuum kit and 90% of dust is gone too. Very happy with itSeems like a really good value. Only used it a little but it seems very well made.solid, easy to use and great for my home projectsNeeded to cut tileBuenaUse this all the time. Used it to scrape mastic off our floor, used it to cut black pipe, used it to fix my car. Excellent deviceExelente producto. Completamente recomendadoAfter reading some of the negative reviews, I was expecting a piece of junk that sounded like a coffee can full of rocks. This tool has a very substantial feel and appears to be good quality. Angle grinders are never the smoothest-running power tools, but this one feels a lot closer to one of my better grinders than it does to one from the local tool place that sells cheap imports; and I have bought many of both. This is definitely better made than the cheapo variety. It is true that the on-off switch is a little stiff. It’ll probably loosen up a bit with use. It’s not a problem in any case. I have expensive angle grinders, but I like to use cheap ones for dirtier jobs that don’t require the power of a more expensive tool. This one will be perfect for that use. 6.2 amps is plenty for many light tasks such as wire brushing the slag off of welds and the like. This is a good buy, and when it does go to tool heaven, the case - and those aren't cheap - will live on.

EDIT: I just spent a full day on a welding project and used this grinder quite a bit. I have several angle grinders with different flap disks, wire brushes, cutoff wheels etc. because no one likes changing the wheels constantly. The last one of my cheap grinders from the freight place stopped working altogether - it's switch hasn't locked for a long time but at least it spun. I replaced it with another one of these Metabo HPTs. They're a good machine for a low price. Hard to beat and even though the price has gone up 25% over what I paid, it's still a very good value.
reviews_1s:
I purchased this to replace the cheap H.F. tool I had owned for years. I wanted an upgrade and seen this with the case which I always appreciate. Let me also say I own a Metabo original 3/4" hammer drill that is 20+ years old and still is my go to hammer drill.. This Metabo HTP is part of Hitachi and I normally don't have a issue with Hitachi but they are not the same class as Metabo and this tool proves it. Let me say I was disappointed most of the tools have a tool free guard adjustment, this tool requires you to get a Phillips screwdriver to adjust the guard which who wants to do that every time? I also am not a fan of the position of the on off switch, its up on the side. I prefer a paddle switch. When I turned this tool on it sounded like there were marbles in the housing. MY old cheap H.F sounded much quieter. I was cutting metal for about 5 min and had to change the wheel and the pin that locks the arbor was jammed, I had to keep turning the wheel hoping it would finally engage. Then it wouldn't release without wiggling the wheel again.. Nope not new this should be so difficult. I couldn't even imagine owning this for any length of time. The casing was so hot after 5 min that I wonder if they shorted the grease or used a cheap grease but no way the case should have been so hot it nearly burned me. With that being said I probably won't ever purchase a Metabo HTP. I really hate giving a bad review but I write what I feel and experience. I am not influenced by rebates, cash back, etc..Product seems to be a great value. However, I used this to do some concrete grinding to take down some high spots prior to laying a floor. First grinder lasted for a total of maybe 4-5 hours of use over the course of 4 days. I was very careful to avoid the motor heating up giving the machine periodic breaks. Still the bearing went bad. First unit was purchased in January and I was outside of my 30 day Amazon window before the grinders first use. Returning that one directly to Metabo for repair.
I purchased a second unit from Amazon to complete the job. I figured I would just end up with two grinders after warranty repair. The second unit failed (again bearing) in less than one hour of use. For those skeptics, I did not exert pressure on the grinder to speed bearing failure. I let the weight of the grinder find the high spots.
I really wanted to like this grinder. Check my ratings and you will find I rarely (if ever) rate something a single star. Two failures with limited use deserve the rating. Good luck if you buy this. I suggest looking elsewhere if you need a tool to finish a job.This grinder is very hard to use the on switch is difficult.Didn't need it until a few weeks after purchase and it won't turn on.
Filed a complaint with no response.

It sounded like the the gears are not aligned because the motor still works but the spindle does not turn..
